scripts.dev: npm run build -w @relaybox/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @relaybox/api" "npm run dev -w @relaybox/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @relaybox/shared && npm run build -w @relaybox/api && npm run build -w @relaybox/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @relaybox/shared && npm run test -w @relaybox/api && npm run test -w @relaybox/web
